An old paper dropped by a pirate during the Liberty Bay raids sends you on a treasure hunt: {npc:Wyrdin} deciphers it, you find a poem pointing to Tiquanda, you put together the four parts of a pirate map with the help of {npc:Klaus}, in Nargor, and finally you solve the four seals of Treasure Hunt Island. At the end you get 3 {item:Gold Ingot|Gold Ingots} and a {item:Bejeweled Ship's Telescope}.
Access to **Nargor** ({wiki:The Shattered Isles Quest}, level 35). Level 60+ recommended.
A {item:Very Old Piece of Paper}, which drops from {wiki:Pirates|pirates} during the {wiki:Liberty Bay Raids|Liberty Bay raids} (or appears on the ground during them).
for the Mac Noodles door (or equivalent)
A melee weapon (to break a wall)
5,000 gp to buy the map part from Klaus
in a container (flask or {item:Vial|vials}); bring a few extra
one per parrot; bring more in case you fail
Daily respawn in the treasure room: 3 {item:Small Emerald|Small Emeralds}, 2 {item:Small Amethyst|Small Amethysts}, 1 {item:Small Topaz} and 162 {item:Gold Coin|Gold Coins}
The quest appears in the Quest Log under **Tibia Tales**.
Bring several containers with rum and more than 2 cookies: if you fail the snake seal or the conversation with the parrots, you need more. If you run out of stock, you can restart the mission.
After you leave the treasure room (or the island) you cannot go back.
1. The encrypted paper and the poem
Use a {item:Fire Bug} on the {item:Very Old Piece of Paper}. It turns into an {item:Old Encrypted Text}.

Go to the Magic Academy in **Edron** and talk to {npc:Wyrdin}: {key:hi}, {key:encrypted text}. He keeps the text and asks for an hour to decipher it. If you are not in Edron, take a boat and tell the captain {key:hi}, {key:edron}, {key:yes}; you arrive at the port, next to {npc:Captain Seahorse}. The Magic Academy is in the centre of the city.
Pick up the poem (1 hour later)
Wait **1 real hour**, go back to Wyrdin and say {key:hi}, {key:decryption}. Go through the {item:Door (Sealed)|sealed door} near him and pick up the {item:Old Pirate Poem (Book)} from the chest.
Find the right tree in Tiquanda

Go to **Port Hope** by boat ({key:hi}, {key:port hope}, {key:yes} to the port captain). The poem speaks of a {item:Giant Tree (Carving)|carved tree} in the jungle of **Tiquanda**. There are three such trees, each with a hidden hole 17 squares to the west. The right one is found by going **west** from the entrance of **Chor**. Walk **17 squares west** of the tree and dig with the {item:Shovel} at this spot. You fall into a small cave with some {wiki:Dworcs}. To get to Chor: if you have the **Ranger** rank in the {wiki:Paw and Fur Society}, {npc:Lorek} takes you there for 30 gp; otherwise cross the southern half of Port Hope and cross the log bridge that leads to Chor.
Where to dig (17 squares west of the tree)
When you complete the next mission you lose access to these three hidden zones. Some players deliberately do not finish the quest because of this.
You need a {item:Voodoo Doll}, which drops from {creature:Dworc Voodoomaster|Dworc Voodoomasters}.
In the cave room, use the {item:Voodoo Doll} on the {item:Campfire (Pot)|pot}. Then examine (look at) the doll: a **4-digit number** appears in the description. Write it down.
There are 1296 possible combinations, but none works before you do the ritual — do not try to guess.
Use the Voodoo Doll on the pot to reveal the code

To the **east** of the cave there are 4 dice. Use the levers of each die to rotate them until they show the code. The **first digit** goes on the **northernmost** die, and the following ones in order going **south**.
Enter the code on the dice to unlock the teleport
Pick up the first part of the map

With the right code, go through the teleport. Use {item:The Remains of a Pirate} to find the {item:Top Right Part of a Map}.

To leave, go back through the teleport to the dice cave and climb up with the {item:Rope} through the hole you dug. Then return to Port Hope the same way.
Where you get the first part of the map
3. The four parts of the map
You need access to **Nargor** and 5,000 gp. Get ready for all kinds of {wiki:Pirates|pirates}.

To get to {wiki:Nargor}: in **Liberty Bay**, on the small peninsula **south-east** of the depot, tell {npc:Captain Waverider} {key:hi}, {key:peg leg}, {key:yes} to go to **Meriana** (50 gp); there, ask {npc:Sebastian}, **south** of Sabrehaven, {key:hi}, {key:nargor}, {key:yes} (50 gp). Go to the tavern in **Nargor** and talk to {npc:Klaus}: {key:hi}, {key:treasure map}, {key:yes}. You pay **5,000 gp** and receive the {item:Top Left Part of a Map}.
Pick up the {item:Logbook of Klaus (Book)} from the chest **north** of Klaus (behind the door) and read it.
Tell Klaus {key:logbook} and ask about the names of the pirates you read: {key:Nutty Jack}, {key:Rapp Scallion} and {key:Captain Nathaniel}. The answers give you the clues for the two missing parts.

In the area of the {wiki:Waterfall Quest}, use the **bottom of a destroyed boat** to find the {item:Lower Left Part of a Map}. You get there as in the {wiki:Waterfall Quest}: from Port Hope cross the jungle **east**, south of {wiki:Banuta}, cross the river by the log ({coord:32950,32645,7}) and go down the hidden hole near {npc:The Blind Prophet} ({coord:32996,32611,7}); the boat is in the cave, to the **west**. To leave, go back to the hole and climb up with the {item:Rope}, and return to Port Hope the same way.
The third part is found by using the bottom of the boat

Go to **Mac Noodles**, a building south of the Dwarven Bridge. Use the {item:Crowbar} on the **west** door to get in and use the wooden floor to the **north-west** to find the {item:Lower Right Part of a Map}. It is on the surface, on the road between Thais and Venore, near Kazordoon: go and come back on foot.
Mac Noodles (enter through the west door)
Use the wooden floor to the north-west to get the last part

With the 4 parts, go back to {npc:Klaus} and say {key:hi}, {key:map}. He joins them together and gives you the {item:Pirate Treasure Map}. To leave Nargor, go back to {npc:Sebastian} ({key:hi}, {key:liberty bay}, {key:yes}) and return to Liberty Bay.
Bring at least 2 {item:Cookie|Cookies} and containers with {item:Rum} (bought in the Liberty Bay tavern, or fill {item:Vial|vials} from the {item:Cask|rum cask} there). Bring extras in case you fail.

In **Liberty Bay**, talk to {npc:Captain Waverider} on the small peninsula **south-east** of the depot and say {key:hi}, {key:treasure island}, {key:yes} (200 gp) to go to **Treasure Island**. Travel with {npc:Captain Waverider} to **Treasure Island**. There, tell him {key:hi}, {key:map} and {key:yes} to sail to **Treasure Hunt Island**.
On the island there is a passage up (a small field of {item:Sugar Cane}) and one down. **Go down the ramp**.
5. First seal: The Riddle of the Snake

On floor -1 there is a teleport next to a bridge guarded by two {item:Pirate Statue|Pirate Statues} — you have to activate it to advance. Head **south** and go down the ramp. You arrive at a room with 2 different ramps; either leads to the destination (one has ramps, the other teleports). In the centre of the area is a shrine with a snake head, a {item:Coal Basin} and an {item:Empty Coal Basin}.
The bridge teleport, between the Pirate Statues
Start by going down the south ramp
Both ramps lead to the snake head area

Use a container with rum on the {item:Empty Coal Basin} and run to the bridge teleport (the one with the Pirate Statues) in **less than 25 seconds**. The route **north-east** from the snake head is probably the fastest: go up the ramp, walk east, levitate down, pass the teleport and run east to the teleport.
If you are not fast enough, use another flask of rum on the basin and try again.
Cross the bridge to the teleport
Go down several ramps to a room with two ramps. The ramp **west and up** leads to the exit; to continue, go down the ramp to the **north-east**.
If you need to leave halfway, the ramp **west and up** in this room leads to the cave exit.
6. Second seal: The Riddle of the Clean Ship Deck

You arrive at a deck with a sign that says *"I hate to sweep the deck!"*. You have to reach the teleport on the other side **without getting hurt** by the blades and spikes. Walk **diagonally** to avoid the traps (if you cannot, use {item:Parcel|parcels}). You cannot step on the {item:Strange Slits}, but you can walk over the {item:Spikes} when they are retracted.
Cross the deck without being hit
If you get hurt, you have to wait for the bloodstains to disappear before trying again.
Boring alternative: use an {item:Energy Ring} or {spell:Magic Shield} and run across.

On the other side there is a room with {item:Crate (Usable)|usable crates} and a teleport. That teleport takes you back to the bridge, and from there you can return to this part whenever you like (without needing rum again). To continue, walk **east**.
7. Third seal: The Riddle of the Sleeping Dead Pirates

You arrive at a hall with sleeping dead pirates and a sign: *"Don't wake the dead they might get mad!"*. Cross without waking them. The best method is to put a gold coin on each safe plank to mark the right path as you go. Use {item:Parcel|parcels} if you cannot walk diagonally.
The hall of the sleeping pirates
The hall of the sleeping dead pirates
Every pirate you wake makes a {creature:Ghostly Apparition} appear and attack you, and you have to enter the nearest {item:Magic Forcefield} to restart this seal.

You have to find out the captain's age with the parrots {npc:Polly} and {npc:Skip}. Talk to **both at the same time** and give a {item:Cookie} to **each one** every time you start a conversation. Say in order: {key:hi}, {key:1}, {key:2}, {key:3}, {key:4}, {key:1}, {key:7}, {key:bye}.
The logic: add up the numbers of the answers from both. When they say *"Ish number... ONE!"* you got the 1st digit right (4); with *"...TWO!"* you got the 2nd (7). The age is **47**.
After they tell you that 4 is number one, say {key:1} straight away. If you repeat the 4 you no longer get the second number without restarting (and wasting more cookies).
Walk **east** and talk to the {npc:Skeleton Guard}: {key:hi}, {key:47}. You can then enter the last teleport, which leads to the treasure room.

The rewards are in {item:Treasure Chest (Ornamented)|ornamented chests} under rubble, in the **north-east** and **south** corners of the room: 3 {item:Gold Ingot|Gold Ingots} and the {item:Bejeweled Ship's Telescope}. In the room there is also a daily respawn of 3 {item:Small Emerald|Small Emeralds}, 2 {item:Small Amethyst|Small Amethysts}, 1 {item:Small Topaz} and 162 {item:Gold Coin|Gold Coins}.
3 Gold Ingots and Bejeweled Ship's Telescope
Location of the Bejeweled Ship's Telescope

Leave through the teleport to the **west**. Then climb the ramps to the surface of Treasure Hunt Island and talk to {npc:Captain Waverider} on the boat ({key:hi}, {key:liberty bay}, {key:yes}; 50 gp) to return to Liberty Bay.
After you leave the treasure room you cannot enter it again; the same happens if you leave the island. Pick up everything first.
